placements.title: Saving a memory quietly assigns governance standing
placements.frame: What review-workflow consequences follow automatically from the act of saving, and who ends up holding reviewer standing as a result?
placements.why: Both segments carry the same directional theme — a ratified rule ('Decision:') that the act of saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer, verified by the e2e suite, with the probe memory existing solely to carry and evidence that rule. This is a subject future envelopes about review/enrollment behavior will keep feeding, not a single measurement, so it earns its own leaf under the newly minted Architecture strata rather than being folded into a fact.
